description: A hook's non-zero exit is logged with its status and the next hook runs.

expect.log:
[ pfB Hook ] post #0 (hook_post_fail.sh, timeout 60s)
failing
[ pfB Hook ] post #0 exited non-zero [ 3 ]; continuing

[ pfB Hook ] post #1 (hook_post_ok.sh, timeout 60s)
[ pfB Hook ] post #1 completed
expect.errors: [ pfB Hook ] post #0 exited non-zero [ 3 ]; continuing
